title: DNase I Treatment in Solution After RNA Extraction
author: Ben Kuipers
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.75ghq3w

steps.title: Prepare DNase I stock solution
steps.instruction: Add 275 µL nuclease‑free water to the lyophilized DNase I from the Promega Maxwell 16 LEV SimplyRNA kit to reconstitute the DNase I stock.

steps.title: Make DNase I reaction mastermix
steps.instruction: Combine 5 µL Buffer RDD (RNase‑Free DNase Set), 1.25 µL DNase I stock (Promega Maxwell 16 LEV SimplyRNA kit), and the eluted RNA sample; then add RNase‑free water to bring the total volume to 50 µL.

steps.title: Incubate reaction at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the 50 µL mixture at room temperature for 60 minutes.

steps.title: Measure nucleic acid concentrations with Qubit
steps.instruction: Use a Qubit fluorometer to determine the concentrations of DNA and RNA in the sample.
